data.name: Settings_RefreshIntervalDescription
data.value: How often the Overview and Processes pages are updated while they are visible.

data.name: Settings_ShowSystemProcessesDescription
data.value: Windows services and system processes are listed with everything else.

data.name: Settings_GroupByApplicationDescription
data.value: The default for the Processes page; the toggle on the page changes it for the session.

data.name: Settings_SensorsDescription
data.value: Reads CPU, motherboard, GPU and drive temperatures. CPU and motherboard sensors need the PawnIO driver from pawnio.eu and administrator rights; WinClean installs neither.

data.name: Settings_TrayEnabled
data.value: Show an icon in the notification area

data.name: Settings_TrayEnabledDescription
data.value: The icon shows live usage and opens WinClean with a click. Sampling continues in the background at a slower pace.

data.name: Settings_CloseToTray
data.value: Keep running when the window is closed

data.name: Settings_CloseToTrayDescription
data.value: Closing the window hides it; Exit in the icon's menu ends WinClean.

data.name: Settings_StartWithWindowsDescription
data.value: Adds WinClean to the Run key of your account; no service and no scheduled task.

data.name: Settings_StartMinimizedDescription
data.value: Only the notification area icon appears at sign-in. Needs the icon to be enabled.

data.name: Settings_CleanupConfirmationDescription
data.value: Always on. Every cleanup shows the exact files first and asks before deleting.

data.name: Settings_TemporaryAgeDescription
data.value: Files younger than this stay, so a running installer or build is never disturbed.

data.name: Settings_StaleDaysDescription
data.value: node_modules, build output and virtual environments in projects untouched for this long are offered for cleanup.

data.name: Settings_NotElevated
data.value: WinClean is running with standard rights. Administrator rights are needed for Windows temporary files, the Windows Update cache, processes of other accounts and CPU sensors.

data.name: Settings_VerboseLoggingDescription
data.value: Writes debug detail to the log files. Useful when reporting a problem.

data.name: Settings_DataFolderPortable
data.value: Portable mode: settings and logs live next to the executable because a file named "portable" sits beside it.

data.name: Settings_DataFolderPerUser
data.value: Settings and logs for this account. Put a file named "portable" next to WinClean.exe to keep them beside the executable instead.

data.name: Settings_DiagnosticsDescription
data.value: What each reader reported on this machine. The same list is written by WinClean.exe --self-check.

data.name: Settings_License
data.value: Open source under the MIT license.

data.name: Settings_Privacy
data.value: No account, no telemetry, no analytics, no crash upload and no update check. WinClean never opens a network connection on its own; links and the Windows Update check only run when you click them.

data.name: Cleanup_DockerDescription
data.value: Unused images, stopped containers and build cache, pruned by Docker itself. Volumes are never touched.

data.name: Cleanup_DeveloperFoldersDescription
data.value: node_modules, build output and virtual environments of projects that have not changed in a while. The tool recreates them; deleting is permanent.

data.value: Some categories can only be cleaned with administrator rights: Windows temporary files, the Windows Update cache, servicing logs and system crash dumps.
